The converse also diverges: a hop fired before the owner's main move counts as that main move and consumes it.

why: On a collection paid by another player the move is a host request, and the body is re-run from the already-moved position. Probe zz_fate_hit_probe::probe_exact_one_copy (p1 owns only {5}): pos=5, fate_hit=0, card in hand at next start; control with p1 owning {5,8}: fate_hit=1, card graveyarded.
suggest: Store the hit on the card instance (`ctx::set_prop`) rather than the shared player slot and move the hit/log before `card_move`; pin the one-tile-ahead case in a test.

sheet_clause:
若此卡打出后
（1）效果未产生作用，将此卡返回手牌（不触发乐队技能的
（3）效果）。
why: `SLOT_HIT` goes through `ctx::slot` -> `Ops::state_get(player_id, key)`, a free-form **per-player** counter (crates/game-core/src/engine/ops.rs:473-480), and `fate_together` resets it to 0 on every Play. The bit therefore answers "did any copy move since the last Play", not "did THIS instance move". Two copies share one bit and read the same value at the same instant, so they always take the same branch: if copy B is played after copy A hopped, the Play reset makes both copies return to hand at turn start -- the copy that did produce a result is wrongly returned instead of being discarded; if the hop lands after the second Play, both are discarded and the copy that never produced a result is wrongly discarded. (The reviewer's 'the copy that never hopped is discarded' half is backwards: with the shared 0 both copies return.)
suggest: Key the hit flag to the field instance (uid prop/counter) instead of the player slot, and write it before the move (see the separate replay finding).

suggest: Accumulate into the slot (old + (20-x)) rather than assigning, and carry an activation count if the abnormal +2 is per activation.

sheet_clause: 若该次移动过程中受到异常移动效果影响，为此卡添加两个奇迹水晶
why: The abnormal comparison is deferred to TurnEnd, not the boosted move's end, so any abnormal landing between the dice roll and turn end counts -- including one from a later move in the same turn or an effect after the move -- while a landing between move start and the roll is folded into the snapshot and missed. The clause scopes the +2 to 「该次移动过程中」. No TODO records it.
suggest: Anchor the abnormal check to the boosted move (a per-move snapshot at move end, or PassTile-based) instead of TurnEnd.

why: The play body never calls `ctx::set_dest(ctx::Dest::Field)`, so `dest_from(DEST_UNSET)` (wasm_rules.rs:9710-9716) maps the play to `Dest::Graveyard` (play.rs:4778-4784 discards it and creates no field instance). Sibling cards that rely on hooks all set Field in the play body (want_human.rs:43, fate_together.rs:47, forever.rs:77, miracle.rs:49), and no TODO records the omission. This also makes findings 1 and 2 latent until fixed.
suggest: Add `ctx::set_dest(ctx::Dest::Field);` before `Ok(())` in `want_to_grab` so the card stays in play for its two hooks.

sheet_clause: 你的下回合开始前

Clause (3) itself is anchored on 「你在回合开始时」, so a TurnStart handler is also the natural place to close the window.

Today that is 60 (data/board.json has 60 tiles), so every face 3..=60 maps identically, including r=60 -> index 59 = 序号 60 per the 0≡60 ruling; the divergence is latent (a record carries its own board per crates/game-core/src/data.rs:17,355-356) and line 40 has no 规则书 citation to tie the board-relative mod back to 「mod60」. Sibling HHW:Happy, Lucky, Smile, Yeah！ also treats the board as fixed 60 and bails on tile_count() != 60 (happy_lucky.rs:60-62).
suggest: Cite 「投掷4次3d20mod60...」 at line 40 and either mod the literal 60 or add a note tying the mod to the fixed 60-tile board.

sheet_clause: 投掷4次3d20mod60并记录其结果，选择其中之一
why: The book says to record the four results and choose one of them; the code pushes only distinct destination tiles, so duplicate sums collapse and the player is offered fewer than the four recorded results (e.g. four 15s yield one option). All four rolls are still consumed by RNG, and the destination outcome is unchanged, so the divergence is display/record-only; the sibling multi-roll card karaoke.rs keeps every result and offers each. There is no TODO(规则书) at the site.
suggest: Keep all four results in roll order (or log each raw result) rather than deduping by tile; if dedup is kept, add a TODO(规则书) at line 41.

sheet_clause: 打出此卡的回合内，你若进行掷骰移动
observed: On::Action(Action::PassTile("card.placed && actor == owner && move.kind != Teleport && move.main && tile.id >= 0", Some(pass_applies), pass_tile)),
why: The gate uses `move.main` as a proxy for 「掷骰移动」, but main = 'the turn's main move', not 'a dice move'. It over-fires on main moves that roll no die -- PPP:向着未来的路标 「本回合的主要移动设为移动60格子」 (signpost.rs:41-44 sets 60 steps and calls card_move as the main move) and 通用:尽力后的收获 「本回合的[主要移动]改为移动1到6以内的任意整数」 (effort.rs:66-69) -- and it under-fires on event-forced dice moves: rules/events/src/asukayama.rs 「然后抽到此卡的玩家移动1d20」 walks a rolled face, but `wasm_rules.rs:3779-3780` marks event moves `plan.forced`, so `card_move` sets `plan.main = false` and the +2 never fires. Note the obvious replacement `move.roll != null` cannot be used as-is: `bridge_trigger` fills `TriggerMove.roll` only for DiceRoll* kinds (wasm_rules.rs:7210-7222), so it is null on PassTile.
suggest: Expose a dice-move/dice-table flag on the PassTile trigger and gate on that instead of move.main.

sheet_clause: 每初次经过一个属于你的格子，使你的总移动数+2
why: The running total is a private instance prop, and `set_extra_steps` assigns (`self.turn.plan.extra_steps = n`, ops.rs:67-68) while the plan is reset to a fresh move at each walk (play.rs:822/850). The card should add to whatever `plan.extra_steps` already holds. Adjusted: a second copy of this card is not normally reachable (roster_order.rs is one row per id), so the two-copy doubling is hypothetical; the surviving conflict is with the only other `set_extra_steps` writer, `rules/skills/skill-personas/src/uika_imprisoned.rs:168` (before_settle), whose value the next pass overwrites with the card's own small count. Not covered by BACKLOG CRYSTAL-07 (mid-walk sync only).
suggest: Add +2 to the plan's current extra_steps (needs a getter/add API) instead of assigning a private running count.

sheet_clause: 使你的总移动数+2
why: Re-read the engine: the walk bound is `steps + m.extra_steps` re-read each iteration (play.rs:1702), and `fold_plan_delta` does copy `extra_steps` (play.rs:133-135) — but only after `moveBefore` (play.rs:1621) and in the teleport path (1860). The step loop's `passTile` raise (play.rs:1745) is followed only by the `stop_at` / `resolve` pulls (1763-1768), no fold, so a plan write made by this hook never reaches `m.extra_steps`. `set_extra_steps` assigns only `TurnCtx::plan.extra_steps` (ops.rs:67-69). The +2 is therefore a no-op on the walk it is earned on. BACKLOG CRYSTAL-07 (docs/rulebook/BACKLOG.md:1518-1525, class A, cites line 173) records it accurately.
suggest: Re-fold the plan after `passTile` (or give the walk a plan->move sync for extra_steps) before the loop condition re-reads it.

sheet_clause: 当此卡位于格子上时，那格视为与“弦卷集团”格子交换位置
why: The clause swaps the square, not just its settle: while the card sits on it, that square IS 弦卷集团. Only the SettleBody (and TileResolved discard) are redirected, so [经过] effects do not swap: passing the card's square still runs the square's own pass rule, and passing 弦卷集团 runs none (the agent tile declares only On::Settle). A card on a tile with a pass reward therefore keeps paying it while treated as 弦卷集团. BACKLOG ABI-13 names this exact clause and this card as the consumer.
suggest: Add the PassTile half of the swap (or land ABI-13's tile-rule swap and drop the hand-rolled redirect).

sheet_clause: 「此卡位于场上时，每次掷骰获得一次资金」
why: bridge_trigger fills `roll: is_roll_kind.then_some(t.value)` for every roll kind (wasm_rules.rs:7193-7210), and diceRollAfter is raised with value = the face, so move_roll() is Some on every diceRollAfter — including a plan's fixed face (which is what t.value holds after `plan.roll = fixed_roll`). The guard therefore never refuses, and a fixed-face main move (ctx::set_fixed_roll from card-crychic/src/karaoke.rs:95, card-mujica/src/uika_fearless.rs:67, skill-personas/rinko_1cm.rs:88) both pays the 700 reward and gets its chosen face replaced by reroll_to_ten whenever the fixed face is below 10, because do_move_roll re-sums the plan tables and ignores fixed_roll (engine/ops.rs:498). The comment describes a skip the code does not have.
suggest: Gate on the plan's fixed face (`plan.fixed_roll == null`, as roll_plan already does) or drop the dead guard and record the extra payout/reroll with TODO(规则书).

sheet_clause: 此卡位于场上时，每次掷骰获得一次资金，起始为700，每次减少100，奖励下限为100。
why: The sheet pays once per dice roll and steps the ladder down once per roll (「每次…每次减少100」). on_roll_after pays once and then calls reroll_to_ten (line 81), whose loop calls ctx::do_move_roll. That path is OP_DO_MOVE_ROLL -> card_do_move_roll (play.rs:2200-2206), which only sums the plan tables and logs a dice line -- it never raises diceRollAfter. roll_direct's `window: false` only removes the separate Roll counteraction link (hostfns.rs:84, wasm_rules.rs:4029-4032); the Action event is a different hook. Verified by running `cargo test -p ruleset-tests --test zz_review_no_road` (4 passed): `review_card_lingers_and_leaks_redirect_into_later_exile` asserts the card is still on_field after its exile ends and then a fresh exile makes the old designatee collect the rent (P1 +260, P0 0).

sheet_clause: （2）[共鸣]交换[拥有者]的抽卡区和弃卡区。
why: These are copies, not moves. `ctx::to_discard` only removes a copy from the hand and pushes the id into the graveyard (`World::to_discard`, ops.rs:1043-1055), so deck cards stay in the deck; `add_to_dest(DeckTop)` pushes into the deck without removing from the graveyard. Every card therefore ends up in BOTH piles: deck = old deck + old discard, discard = old discard + old deck. Probes: deck=[GREAT], discard=[PERFECT] (plus the 共鸣 fuel just filed) produced deck=[共鸣,PERFECT,GREAT] and discard=[PERFECT,共鸣,GREAT] -- 3 physical cards now in 6 slots; the first probe showed 2+2 cards becoming 5+5. The deck is never actually cleared and the discard never ends up holding the old deck alone. No swap test exists in spec_card_pp.rs and BACKLOG has no item for it.
suggest: Remove each card from its source pile while moving it (take from deck/graveyard), or snapshot for logging, clear one pile, then move the other's cards in -- never copy.

id: RAS:（和奏瑞依）寄于指尖的执念
sheet_clause: 保留（写下）未被选择的另一个骰点
why: The keep hook is on the outer diceRollAfter and cannot line up with the counteraction play. The fire reroll is a nested ctx::roll (raise_effort.rs:78) that raises only diceRollBefore, and the counteract window opens and resolves *before* 择其一执行; the card is placed during that nested window while the enclosing diceRollAfter hook walk iterates a world snapshot taken earlier (wasm_rules.rs:5006), so the freshly placed card is never visited. Probe8 with a temporary placement in counter_fire: card sits on the field, layerUnused=7 seeded, count=0 and no layer_keep_kept — the hook never ran.
suggest: Do not rely on the outer DiceRollAfter walk: record the unchosen face from the reroll body after the pick (or re-raise the keep point after placement).

id: RAS:（和奏瑞依）寄于指尖的执念
sheet_clause: 可保留多个骰点
why: Only hand cards are offered as counters unless the card carries prop COUNTERACT_FROM_FIELD (has_field_counter wasm_rules.rs:6584, declare_one:6723; tae_police.rs:60 and sayo_thorns.rs:55 set it). This CardDef has no `.props(...)` at all, so once the card is placed (the fixed placement of the counter body) it is never offered on a later fire reroll. The second and following dice can never be banked: 「可保留多个骰点」 is unreachable.
suggest: Add `.props(&[(card_sdk::abi::prop::COUNTERACT_FROM_FIELD, 1)])`; consider `COUNTERACT_GROUP` as tae_police does so the placed card cannot re-offer itself in the same round.

id: RAS:（和奏瑞依）寄于指尖的执念
sheet_clause: 可打出此卡并保留（写下）未被选择的另一个骰点
why: A counteraction declaration dispatches only the Counteract entry (host.rs:1539 `Call::Counteract => self.counteract_entry`), never the play body that holds `set_dest(Field)`+`place_card`. `counter_fire` only logs, so `dest` stays DEST_UNSET and dest_from maps it to Graveyard. The generic play is rejected in the window (`t.play` -> Err("err.play_phase"), play.rs:4667). even_lost::counteract does exactly this placement in its counter body.
suggest: Do set_dest(Field)+place_card in counter_fire (as even_lost does) and keep `play` for the press branch.

id: RAS:（和奏瑞依）寄于指尖的执念
sheet_clause: 当你使用火罐进行掷骰时，可打出此卡并保留（写下）未被选择的另一个骰点
why: cant_play admits the card in the ordinary play phase, but the sheet's play is tied to a fire roll. `play` then only places the card and banks nothing (there is no roll), and with the missing COUNTERACT_FROM_FIELD the placed card cannot answer a later fire reroll either -- so a premplay leaves it inert and the hand copy is gone.
suggest: Gate the placement branch on an in-flight CHARGE roll, or rely on the field-counter prop so a premplay stays usable.

why: Action::TurnEnd fires at EVERY player's turn end (play.rs:744 raises with the turn player), and this entry has no `actor == owner` gate, so the owner is charged 400 and loses a crystal on opponents' turn ends too. Probed on a 2-player table: own turn end money 10000->9600, crystals 9->8; immediately ending the opponent's turn money 9600->9200, crystals 8->7. Every sibling decay card with the same bare 「每回合结束时」 wording gates the owner's turn: j11.rs body `trigger::player_id() != player_id` guard, sports_talent.rs:20 `actor == owner`, that_day_rain.rs:124-126, tritone.rs:71, endless_journey.rs:20. sheet_clause: 自己的所有格子收费变成1.5倍
why: The cell anchors the multiplier on the TILE (your tiles' charge), the pre anchors on the payee (`target == owner`). A payee redirect at paySplitAdd runs before paySplitMul: MyGO:无路矢 retargets its owner's rent to the designated player (no_road.rs:23 body → set_pay_target), so at paySplitMul target != owner and the 1.5x silently drops. The inverse also diverges: someone else's tile rent redirected TO the owner is wrongly boosted. The tile anchor already exists in the vocabulary and is used elsewhere (tomorrows_door.rs:28 `tile.owner == owner`; the raise passes the tile at play.rs). The doc comment at 79-80 ("Rent paid to this card's owner...") repeats the payee reading, while the header paraphrase at line 8 ("all your tiles charge 1.5x rent") is tile-anchored.
suggest: Anchor the pre on the tile: `card.placed && pay_is_rent && tile.owner == owner` (add `tile.id >= 0`).

With AG:（摩卡）0.5倍速 placed (filter `actor == owner && card.placed && value > 0`, moca_half.rs:57) the 1600 is folded to 800 at paySplitMul, so the clause is fulfilled yet the body returns early: the card is spent (money -800, to discard), never placed, no crystals, no X prompt. NFO has no play condition (On::Play("", None, play)), so such a copy does satisfy 「满足打出条件的卡」 and is wrongly hidden (and `nfo_no_replay` can say nothing is playable when only that copy exists). Duplicates reach hand/discard via copy effects (e.g. roselia.rs:120 sets two 曲奇时间 in hand).

sheet_clause: 若此卡进入弃牌堆时结算获得的资金小于本卡原应拿到的资金或未结算则获得发动此卡消耗的资金
why: Confirmed against the engine: SettleStage::RaiseSettle goes straight to RaiseTileResolved when the settle is cancelled (play.rs:2105 `if self.out(i) || t.is_cancelled()`), and RaiseSettleAfter skips the raise when the payer is out/game over (play.rs:2135). settle_after is the only site that discards the card (line 180) and the only site that clears SLOT_STOP (line 175), so in both cases the card stays on the field with SLOT_STOP=1. Because settle_after has no tile/actor guard, the next ordinary settle at that tile then fires it: the card is discarded and the full rent (now unhalved) is compared to the halved expect, so nothing is refunded even though the forced stop was never settled. The clause ties the refund to entering the discard and to 未结算, not to a completed SettleAfter.
suggest: Handle the card entering the discard itself (Action::Discarded(MINE)) and/or clear SLOT_STOP when the forced stop's settle is cancelled or the payer is out; refund per 「未结算」.

sheet_clause: 使下一个经过且移动终点不在此各的你以外的玩家强制停下并触发结算
why: Confirmed and reproduced. SLOT_PAID/SLOT_GOT/SLOT_STOP are per-player, but two placed copies are legal (each copy is its own instance and field hook; ops.rs field_instances: "two copies of the same card are two hooks"). settle_after's only guard is the shared per-player SLOT_STOP; it never compares the running instance's tile with the settled tile (unlike pass_tile/pay_after). So on a forced settle of copy B, whichever copy sits earlier in placement order consumes the shared flag: it discards ITSELF (the wrong instance), computes expect from its OWN tile's rent (ctx::self_tile is the running instance), refunds against the shared SLOT_PAID (the later placement's cost), and copy B then returns early. Probe: copies on tile 1 and tile 7, P1 passes tile 7 -> after settle field tiles = [7], discard = [card]; correct result would be field tiles = [1] with no refund.
suggest: Make settle_after require trigger::tile() == self_tile() (and only then consume SLOT_STOP), or key the whole per-copy state (paid/got/stop) per placed instance instead of per player.
